preconditions.description: The number of genes G must be greater than 2.
The number of rows in the mutation table N must be at least G - 2.
The number of antibodies M must be non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= a < G for a in mutation_table)
preconditions.description: All genes in the mutation table must be between 2 and G - 1.
The total number of genes in all mutation sequences must not exceed 100.
The total length of all antibodies must not exceed 50.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if all viruses from the gene can be detected, otherwise output 'NO' followed by the minimal length of the undetectable virus.
The minimal length of the undetectable virus must be less than 2^63.
